Name: Kill NPC
Author: qishuiQWQ
Description:
[size=4][b]描述：
  English[/b][/size]：Frustrating to want to kill an NPC but can't bring yourself to do it? Don't worry, you've come to the right place! This mod lets you kill any NPC you want to eliminate at will. How to use: Press K to attack an NPC, press L to view the number of currently dead NPCs. After killing an NPC, you can also resurrect it. NPCs will resurrect after 30 days by default. If you don't want NPCs to resurrect for that long, or if you want to resurrect a specific NPC, simply check the corresponding option in the mod settings and save.

   Update notes: Bug fixes: Fixed an issue where all NPCs couldn't resurrect on the same day due to the resurrection slider's time limit.
Updated the mechanism for NPCs dropping items upon death, and resurrected NPCs will have unique dialogue when attacked.

  Chinese：恨不得杀了某个NPC却又下不了手，是不是很让人抓狂？别担心，你来对地方了！这个mod可以让你随心所欲地杀死所有你想除掉的NPC。使用方法：按K键攻击NPC，按L键查看当前已死亡的NPC数量。杀死NPC后，你还可以复活它。NPC默认会在30天后复活。如果你不想让NPC复活这么久，或者想复活某个特定的NPC，只需在mod设置中勾选相应的选项并保存即可。
  更新说明：错误修复：修复了由于复活滑块的时间限制导致所有NPC无法在同一天复活的问题。更新了NPC死亡后会掉落物品的机制，并且复活的NPC在被攻击时会有独特的对话。。[size=4][b]
[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]安装说明：
[size=4]English[/size]：Place the module in the Stardew Valley\Mods folder, and then run StardewModdingAPI.[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Chinese：将模组放入Stardew Valley\Mods文件夹，然后运行​​StardewModdingAPI。[/color]

[size=4][b]主要功能[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]：Chinese：杀死你讨厌的NPC。
[/color][size=4]English[/size]：Kill the NPC you hate.

[size=4][b]要求[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]：Chinese：前置条件：SMAPI（Stardew Modding API）、通用模组配置菜单(GMCM)，[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
[size=4]English[/size]：Prerequisites: SMAPI (Stardew Modding API), General Module Configuration Menu (GMCM)，[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][/color]

[size=4][b]致谢：[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]这是一个测试模组~
This is a test module.[/color]
